review: UI Spec Studio v1.11.0 local README visual review
result: No blocking README visual defect found within the stated local-review scope. No README source edits made.

renderer.kind: Markdown-It with a GitHub-like stylesheet; not pixel-identical to GitHub

font_setup.reason: Observed missing CJK glyphs in initial local render
font_setup.scope: Temporary fontconfig environment for local review; no repository source changes

renderer.launch: Default sandbox denied Chromium startup; authorized local verification completed using an approved escalated browser launch.

actual_visual_scope.image_opening_method: tools.view_image with original detail for viewport and section crops, high detail for tall full-document overview, emitted as image output and visually inspected.
actual_visual_scope.source_read_scope: Read both current README source files and the maintained preview workflow. The rendered fine-detail review covers the initial viewports and the complete new art-direction section; other rendered content is covered only at overview scale.
actual_visual_scope.crop_method: Measured target h2 and next h2 using the same renderer, viewport, theme and temporary font configuration. Verified document height against the final full image; cropped those exact PNG pixels with no resampling.
actual_visual_scope.crop_viewing_note: A six-image crop output was truncated by context capacity and was not counted as review evidence. All 12 crops were subsequently opened and inspected in smaller successful batches.
target_headings: Give familiar work an independent visual language
让熟悉的任务拥有独立的视觉语言

automated_checks_from_maintained_runner.artwork: All rendered assets loaded; correct compact asset at 390 px and wide asset at 768/1440 px, with theme-matching source.
automated_checks_from_maintained_runner.install_command: Native DOM code text contains the complete expected primary installation command in all conditions. No clipboard operation was tested.
automated_checks_from_maintained_runner.disclosure: The first details disclosure was opened and closed by click in all 12 conditions. Images were captured before these actions. This does not verify every disclosure or a full keyboard journey.
automated_checks_from_maintained_runner.image_alt: Expected artwork alt text present in all conditions.

findings.observed: The initial Chinese 390 px viewport displayed missing-glyph boxes; the English viewport also lacked Chinese locale-link glyphs.
findings.cause_evidence: No CJK fonts were returned by fc-list :lang=zh in the initial environment.
findings.action: Downloaded official Noto CJK regular and bold collections and used an isolated Fontconfig file. The maintained CSS already names Noto Sans CJK SC, so no style/source change was required. Recreated all 24 screenshots.
findings.verification: The final initial viewports and all Chinese target-section crops show readable Chinese glyphs.

findings.observed: The art-direction section has a distinct heading, three readable paragraphs, selective bold terms and a visible guide link at every captured width/theme. Surrounding section boundaries remain clear.
findings.decision: No layout correction indicated within these conditions.

findings.observed: At 768 px in both themes, the final character 计 of 艺术指导与表达性设计 wraps onto a separate line. The link remains complete and readable.
findings.decision: Reported to root; no source change proposed for this ordinary responsive line wrap.

findings.observed: At 390 px, the native code line extends beyond the visible code region horizontally. The complete command is present in the DOM; the page itself does not overflow. The English install block enters the bottom of the initial viewport; the Chinese install block is visible.
findings.basis: Initial 390 px viewport images plus maintained DOM checks.
findings.decision: No clipping-loss claim: horizontal code scrolling and clipboard copying were not exercised in this review.

findings.observed: Title, tagline, responsive artwork, locale/navigation links, introduction and install entry maintain a clear sequence. The 768/1440 px views also show native installation and first-task content without overlap. Dark backgrounds preserve discernible text/emphasis/link separation.
findings.basis: Twelve actual viewport-image reads. This is visual inspection, not measured contrast compliance or user testing.

findings.observed: Overview images retain coherent section rhythm and artwork placement, with no large visible layout break.
findings.basis: Twelve tall full-document images viewed at overview scale.
findings.decision: No fine-readability conclusion is drawn from the reduced full-document previews.

superseded_capture_policy: The initial 24 images under superseded-missing-cjk are excluded from final quality claims. Only their en-light-390 and zh-light-390 viewport files were actually viewed before the environment repair, as recorded in scope.json.

evidence_limits: Local Markdown-It rendering with a GitHub-like stylesheet; no live GitHub page, live commit, branch page, release page or published rendering was viewed.
Operating-system fonts and the temporary Noto CJK setup influence glyph metrics; this review does not establish identical wrapping on other systems.
Tall full-page images were viewed as overviews only; fine text and glyph judgments rely on the initial viewports and the native-pixel art-direction crops.
The guide link and other navigation targets were visually reviewed but not clicked during this local pass.
The primary install command is native complete DOM text; clipboard copying and horizontal scrolling of narrow code containers were not tested.
Only the first details disclosure was exercised by the maintained runner; full keyboard, screen-reader, accessibility, comprehension and user-task validation remain outside scope.
This README review is static and does not validate application motion, runtime performance, product behavior or the methodological capability claims made by the documentation.
No repository files were edited, no code was committed, and no content was published by this review.
